content: Pranav Mishra checked in with insurance agent Neha Kapoor to confirm receipt of a returned form and verify if his policy was now active. Neha confirmed she had received the form and indicated that the policy was nearly finalized, with activation expected by the end of the day. Neha committed to sending a confirmation email once the updates were complete, and Pranav acknowledged the timeline.
